purpose: installs, reports, and updates the tools the gate runs, whatever manages them
usage: kit toolchain list | install | outdated [--check] | update | path | run <command>…

list.description: prints each declared toolchain and the file it reads

outdated.description: prints one line per tool behind its latest version

--check.description: with outdated: fails when any tool is behind

update.description: updates every toolchain to its latest versions, and rewrites its pins and lock

path.description: prints the directories that put the tools first on PATH, one per line, for a runner

run.description: runs the command with the tools: inside the container for docker, else with the toolchains' directories first on PATH

<command>.description: with run: the command and its arguments, as typed; a word that starts with - is the command's, not kit's
